chain.label: Captain fatigued before the flight
chain.trigger: the captain had been awake for all but about 1 hour of the previous 32 hours

chain.label: Shuttle America's attendance policy discouraged fatigue calls
chain.trigger: Shuttle America's failure to administer an attendance policy that permitted flight crewmembers to call in as fatigued without fear of reprisals

chain.label: Captain did not report fatigue or remove himself from duty
chain.trigger: The captain did not advise Shuttle America of his fatigue or remove himself from duty because he thought he would be terminated

caused_by.evidence: his lack of sleep affected his ability to concentrate and process information to make decisions
he did not cancel his trip because he thought that could result in his termination

chain.label: Flight crew did not read preflight NOTAM on glideslope minimums
chain.trigger: both pilots indicated that they had not read this NOTAM

caused_by.evidence: the captain did not adequately review the flight release paperwork, which would have provided him with an early warning of the glideslope status

chain.label: Crew used ILS decision height instead of localizer minimums, assuming glideslope was normal
chain.trigger: they used the ILS decision height (DH)... instead of the localizer (glideslope out) minimum descent altitude

caused_by.evidence: flight crewmembers assumed that the glideslope was working properly

chain.label: Runway 28 was snow-contaminated with fair-to-nil braking action and only 6,017 feet long
chain.trigger: braking action 'fair'... runway 28 was 6,017 feet long and 150 feet wide

chain.label: Weather rapidly deteriorated with heavy snow during the approach
chain.trigger: moderate to heavy snow reported during the approach and at the time of the landing

chain.label: Runway environment not distinctly and identifiably visible to the captain near decision height
chain.trigger: the captain indicated that he could not see the end of the runway

caused_by.evidence: a snow squall came through and he 'could not see anything'
used the ILS DH... instead of the higher localizer MDA

chain.label: Flight crew failed to execute a missed approach
chain.trigger: 'let's go [around]' ... the first officer stated, 'I got the end of the runway' and continued the approach

caused_by.evidence: when the captain called for a go-around because he could not see the runway environment, the first officer should have immediately executed a missed approach

chain.label: First officer's long landing and crew's failure to use reverse thrust/braking to maximum effectiveness
chain.trigger: the airplane touched down about 2,900 feet down the 6,017-foot runway... commanded reverse thrust tapered off to reverse idle during the landing rollout

caused_by.evidence: the flight crewmembers did not use reverse thrust and braking to their maximum effectiveness
long landing on a short contaminated runway

chain.label: Airplane overran the end of runway 28
chain.trigger: it overran the end of the runway

chain.label: Airplane struck ILS antenna and perimeter fence; nose gear collapsed
chain.trigger: contacted an instrument landing system (ILS) antenna, and struck an airport perimeter fence. The airplane's nose gear collapsed

caused_by.evidence: overran the end of the runway
the airplane received substantial damage from impact forces
